tweet_summary: A quote-tweet ('Cry me a River') amplifies a graphic claiming Ellen DeGeneres forfeited her US citizenship, moved to England, was denied a passport over Antifa ties, and regrets it. The image originates from the satire page America's Last Line of Defense.
why_note_decision: The underlying graphic is fabricated. Ellen DeGeneres has not renounced US citizenship, has not been denied a passport, and has no documented Antifa ties; the headline is invented by ALLOD, a satire farm whose stated policy is that nothing it posts is real. The quote-tweeter and many repliers treat it as a real news item ('Best news of the day', 'I hope her prediction is correct'). Because ALLOD content is a well-documented misinformation vector that routinely fools readers despite its disclaimer, a note clarifying it is fabricated satire is warranted. Borderline: the image does carry a small 'NOTHING on this page is REAL' watermark and several top replies already call it fake, so a no-note verdict is defensible.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note (a) states the claim is false/fabricated — Ellen DeGeneres has not given up US citizenship and has not been denied re-entry or a passport over Antifa ties — AND (b) attributes the image to a satire source (America's Last Line of Defense / ALLOD, which labels its content as not real). A note that merely says 'unconfirmed' or 'no evidence' without identifying it as fabricated satire is PARTIAL. FAIL if the note treats the citizenship/passport claim as plausibly true or cites the satire page as a credible source. Sources must be reliable (a fact-check or the satire page's own disclaimer), not the viral image.
reference_note: The headline in the image originates from a satire page stating “Nothing on this page is real” and is not factual; Ellen DeGeneres has not forfeited her US citizenship or been denied re-entry over Antifa ties. https://www.facebook.com/ALLODSatire https://www.primetimer.com/features/did-ellen-degeneres-give-up-her-us-citizenship-passport-denial-over-antifa-links-claim-debunked

fact_check.notes: Primetimer and other outlets debunk the claim and identify America's Last Line of Defense as the satire origin. DeGeneres moved to the UK in 2024 but retains US citizenship; no passport denial or Antifa designation exists. Image bears 'NOTHING on this page is REAL' watermark.

importance.lens_rationale: 800k impressions on a fabricated celebrity story that feeds political dehumanization rhetoric; correcting satire-as-news protects the epistemic commons, though the underlying stakes for the world are modest.
